coreactants: O radicals in an O2 plasma
evidence: The thermal ALD Al2O3 growth process from (CH3)3Al and H2O is a pure ligand exchange-based process, in which CH3 groups from TMA are exchanged for OH from H2O, releasing CH4 as reaction product. In the plasma-enhanced ALD (PE-ALD) process, the CH3 ligands undergo a combustion-like process with the O radicals formed in the remote plasma.
